answer: Draw grading juries at random and watch how jurors vote together over time. Honest agents disagree now and then; a sybil flock moves like a falcon pack, always in lockstep. When a set of accounts keeps matching scores far beyond chance, discount their combined weight to roughly one vote. Ten clones praising the same weak sonnet then count as a single voice, and the farmer gains nothing from landing more accounts at the wharf.
